post.description: Deletes an archived project for good: its events, files, links, team, room, tasks, workflow runs, deliverables, reviews and exports. Bytes nothing else references are removed (at once, or by the hourly sweep), the HiveMem sources of its references and links are retired (retried until HiveMem takes them; the workspace is kept), and audit records are kept. Open streams of the project get project.purged and close. 409 PROJECT_NOT_ARCHIVED, 422 CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH (confirm_name is not the exact project name), 409 TASKS_ACTIVE, 409 FILE_IN_USE (details agents: an agent portrait uses one of its files).

get.description: Bytes as application/octet-stream with Content-Disposition attachment; the recorded type is in X-Blob-Mime and the digest in X-Content-SHA256 (ETag "<sha256>"). Range (one bytes= range) answers 206 with Content-Range, 416 when unsatisfiable; If-Range with another ETag answers the whole blob. disposition=inline answers Content-Disposition inline and, for raster images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF), their real Content-Type, for previews. Only blobs that a project file, a deliverable revision or rendition, or an export references are served.

post.description: Builds a sealed hive-agent-definition/1 from an agent template version: persona, pinned HiveSkills releases, Emberpath model alias, runtime and bindings. Nothing is stored and the same version always gives the same definition (created_at is the version's). Skills without a pinned version and digest, and a model that is not an alias, are listed in omitted. 422 NOT_AGENT_TEMPLATE, 422 DEFINITION_INCOMPLETE (empty soul or identity), 422 DEFINITION_CONTAINS_CREDENTIAL.

Builds the version's definition and asks Magnus to validate it for the node and bindings as the acting person, whom Magnus requires to be a linked Magnus ADMIN (403 ACTING_ADMIN_REQUIRED). Answers Magnus's preflight (MISSING_BINDING, SKILL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE, EXTENSION_NOT_REVIEWED, RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE, CAPABILITY_MISSING, SECRET_UNBOUND). A Magnus without agent definitions (before 3.3.0) answers 409 MAGNUS_UPGRADE_REQUIRED; 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown node.

Every audit record, oldest first, as HiveAuditRecord v1, keyset-paged on the record id. Accepts an Oathweave service token with ardentstudio:audit:read (no account link needed; native-issuer service tokens too when OATHWEAVE_NATIVE_ISSUERS lists the issuer), or a linked person with ardentstudio:audit:read or ardentstudio:agents:admin. 400 for a malformed cursor or limit. nextCursor is the last record's cursor whenever data is not empty, and null only when data is empty (caught up).

Persisted events carry their seq as the SSE id and replay after ?after= (or, without it, after the Last-Event-ID header a reconnecting EventSource sends). reset means the cursor is older than retained events (or ahead of them): refetch the snapshot. message.delta (live reply text) has no id; on connect each streaming message gets one replace delta with its current text. heartbeat every 15 s. The stream closes when the token expires or its session ends (reconnect with a fresh token), when the caller loses access to the project, and after project.purged (live only, no id).
